item.ptxt: This DTC is displayed on the service inspection screen.
The display consists of the logical address (2-digit base 16 number) - DTC (2-digit base 16 number).
Logical address 01: Communication control
Logical Address 34: Front Seat Monitor
Logical Address 40:TV Tuner
Logical Address 57: Telephone Drawing
Logical Address 58: Navigation
Logical Address 60: Radio Unit
Logical Address 62:CD-P
Logical Address 64:MD-P
